Sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] '''invaded''' the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Florn system/Legends|Florn system]]. The battle followed the [[Battle of the Kaelta system|capture]] of the [[Kaelta system]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were victorious in the Florn system as well, and the raid was the last battle of that particular campaign.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.<ref name="Atlas" />
